column2: A cat naps in the sun.
Pass the pan to Mum, please.
The cat ran past the tent.
Sam taps the desk with a pen.
The tip of the pen is red.
The tips of the pins are sharp.
An ant is on the step.
An ant is on the leaf.
The ant is in the tin.
The bridge has a long span.
Dad did a stint on the farm.
The tin is on the shelf.
An ant is in the pit.
Pat tips his tin to the ant.
The ant sits in the tin. Tap, tap!
Nan sits in the pit. She pats Pat.
Pat is in the pit. He naps.
Pat has a cast on his leg.
The cat sat on the mat.
Two cats nap on the bed.
Pack your bag for the trip.
Tidy up is a big task.
We spent a day at the park.
A hen was in a nest.
Hana can pet the hen. Pat, pat.
Peck, peck! The hen pecks the hat.
Be in the nest, hen! Do sit!
Nan, pat me! Nan pats Hana. Hana naps.
The cat is on the mat.
Sam met Pat at the park.
Hamid and Dad pack a tent.
Dad and Hamid set the tent in a camp.
No, cat! It is my tent! said Hamid.
The cat is sad. Hamid is sad, so he pets it.
It can nap in the tent, said Dad.
Hamid, Dad and the cat nap. All nap in the tent!
The snake is in the grass.
A dog runs on the farm.
The cat is on the mat.
Huda and Mum run to the pond.
Come, Huda! Here is the pond.
There is a duck on it!
Huda got a hot crust in a sack.
You can drop a crust, said Mum. "It is your crust."
Huda drops it. Peck, peck! The duck gets it.
Ten ducks come. They peck and peck!
The cat sits on my lap.
Put the lid on the pot.
Sam is fond of his cat.
It is hot but I am fine.
Adam and Mum get on a big bus.
I like the bus! said Adam.
The bus stops at a big pond.
Adam can spot one red hen and some ducks.
An old dog can dig in the mud on a hill.
Only one stop, and Adam and Mum get off.
The cat has a long tail.
Jamila and Dad sit in a little boat.
The boat floats on a big pond.
What can live in the pond? said Jamila.
Ducks live in it, said Dad.
Rain! Drip, drop, drip. Rain drips down.
I have a coat, said Dad. Dad can give Jamila his coat.
They get off the boat and run to a big oak.
Jamila is damp, but Jamila is glad.
Bilal and Dad see a goat on a hill.
Who is it? said Bilal. "It is a goat," said Dad.
The goat is big and soft.
Do we have any oats? said Bilal. Dad had some oats.
Where can we go? said Bilal.
Which tree? Why not the big oak tree? said Dad.
Bilal, Dad and the goat stand at the big oak tree.
When the rain stops, Bilal and the goat run on the green grass.
The sun sets in the west.
Nan helps Hafsa swing up, up, up!
Many ducks were on the grass. One duck sat on the other swing!
Before Hafsa and Nan go back, they sit on the green grass and drink milk.
I am glad because you swing me, Nan!
Take the cat to the vet.
Idris looks up. The moon is big.
I want to see the moon! said Idris.
A cool wind. Rain drops on the roof.
Could I go up on the roof?
You should not. It is wet, said Mum.
So Idris put on his wool hat and sits on a soft rug in his room.
He looks and looks at the moon.
I saw the moon! I would like to look at it soon, and Dad too!
Mum made Malak a lunch box: a bun, a fig and four nuts.
At lunch, Malak lifts the lid.
Malak checks the nuts: one, two... four!
Yuck! A bug is on the bun!
Does it sting? said Malak. "No," said Mum.
Malak picks it up and sets it on the grass. The bug goes off.
Right! "Bismillah," said Malak, and Malak can munch the bun. Yum!
Put the trash in the bin.
Once, Yusuf and Dad went to the docks.
A big ship is in the port, and lots of fish swim next to it.
Yusuf and Dad sit on the deck of their little boat.
Dad got his fishing rod. Yusuf got his net.
Splash! Yusuf gets a fish in his net!
That fish is thin and fast. Dad also gets a fish.
Then Dad and Yusuf had fish and chips for lunch.
We must always thank Allah, said Dad.
Ilham found a coin on the ground. It is big and thick.
It is not our coin, said Mum.
Ilham and Mum went to the shop.
Ilham said to the man, "I found this coin."
I lost it after lunch! said the man. He thanks Ilham.
Every good deed counts, said Mum. "I love you, Ilham."
It is dark. Amin is out in the yard with his father.
A big star is up in the dark.
Look, Dad! Is that star far?
It is far, far, far, said Dad.
A cloud floats past. The star is lost!
